statement: Create new content in textures with "New Texture"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.
Copy content in textures with "Copy Texture Slot Settings"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in textures with "Move Texture Slot"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.
Paste previously copied content in textures with "Paste Texture Slot Settings"; the pasted items match what was copied, land where Blender 5.3 puts them, and one undo step removes them.
